content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-honest-side|Digital Product]] creators in regions with restricted payment platforms face a significant challenge: how to sell their products online. They need a reliable solution for storing and delivering digital products without relying on conventional payment processors like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-9|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] or PayPal. Enter [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-8|cloudflare]] R2. This infrastructure not only provides a cost-effective way to store digital products but also ensures seamless delivery directly to customers. With the right setup, creators can take charge of their sales without incurring hefty fees from platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale, compared to NOWPayments' mere 0.5%. In this breakdown, we’ll outline how to leverage Cloudflare R2 effectively for your digital product business.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today: Cloudflare digital

To deploy this system, start by signing up for a Cloudflare account and creating an R2 bucket to store your digital products. Next, set up your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle product requests and deliveries. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that you understand how to configure it for on-chain verification. After your payment processing is in place, upload your digital products to R2 and test the automated delivery process to ensure everything works seamlessly. Finally, provide clear instructions for your customers on how to access their purchases. By following these steps, you can create a robust digital storefront that avoids traditional platform pitfalls and keeps more revenue in your pocket.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Keep 99.5% of your revenue with low fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by leveraging Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This approach allows you to maintain full control over your sales while minimizing fees. By integrating these tools, you can create an efficient sales process that delivers products directly to your customers without relying on conventional payment platforms.
Automate product delivery for seamless customer experience.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a Cloudflare account and set up an R2 bucket for your digital products. 2. Upload your digital files to the R2 bucket, ensuring they are organized for easy retrieval. 3. Set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery upon payment confirmation. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, configuring it to accept various cryptocurrencies. 5. Test the entire purchase and delivery process to ensure customers receive their products seamlessly. 6. Provide clear instructions on your website for customers to access their purchased digital goods.

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to use a combination of Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup minimizes costs and maximizes your revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by utilizing Cloudflare R2 to store your files and NOWPayments to handle payments. This offers a sovereign solution for your digital sales.
How do I automate delivery of digital products?

You can automate the delivery of digital products by integrating Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script with your Cloudflare R2 storage. This setup allows for instant delivery upon payment confirmation.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction with no hidden costs, making it a cost-effective option compared to traditional platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%.
